name: Winny Immigration & Education Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Winny Immigration & Education Services Ltd provides services relating to immigration, Visa, and Coaching etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Winny is an Immigration and visa service 
 provider which helps individuals and families 
 in living, working, traveling, or studying in a 
 new country. It has ~12 offices at different locations and a team of ~290 professionals 
 who have assisted around over 6 million 
 clients
